plans.name: Medicare Blue Choice 028 (HMO)

premium.notes: Part B premium still applies. Optional dental costs an additional $35/month.

moop.notes: In-network medical maximum; excludes Part D and premiums.

specialist.notes: In-network specialist visit; service-specific rules apply.

hospital.notes: Modeled in-network seven-day admission: daily copay on days 1–5; days 6+ fully covered.

hearing.notes: Advanced TruHearing option; per hearing aid, not a cash allowance. Confirm fitting and network rules.

transportation.notes: Routine transportation explicitly not covered; ambulance is a separate medical benefit.

benefit_review_notes.dental: Included preventive dental services, not a verified dollar allowance. Optional comprehensive dental: up to $1,000/year for an additional $35/month; not included in the base premium.
benefit_review_notes.otc: No OTC allowance verified; do not interpret missing information as $0.

plans.scope_note: Document-based 2027 comparison. Medication entries are candidate matches. Provider/facility results are dated PDF listings, not live network verification. Optional dental costs extra.

drug_costs.conditions: Preferred network retail, 30-day supply, initial coverage, without Extra Help. Standard pharmacies and longer supplies differ. Insulin has special cost-sharing rules; verify the prescription and pharmacy.
drug_costs.deductible_note: $700 deductible for Tiers 2–5; $0 for Tier 1. Full applicable drug cost applies until the deductible is met.
